assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder
assertions.predicate: abnormalities of beliefs, thinking, and perception
assertions.quote: Abnormalities of beliefs, thinking, and perception are below the threshold for the diagnosis of a psychotic disorder.

assertions.subject: Delusional disorder
assertions.quote: Delusional disorder is characterized by at least 1 month of delusions but no other psychotic symptoms.

assertions.subject: Delusional disorder
assertions.quote: Delusional disorder is characterized by at least 1 month of delusions but no other psychotic symptoms.

assertions.subject: Brief psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: Brief psychotic disorder lasts more than 1 day and remits by 1 month.

assertions.subject: Schizophreniform disorder
assertions.quote: Schizophreniform disorder is characterized by a symptomatic presentation equivalent to that of schizophrenia except for its duration (less than 6 months) and the absence of a requirement for a decline in functioning.

assertions.subject: Schizophreniform disorder

assertions.subject: Schizophrenia
assertions.quote: Schizophrenia lasts for at least 6 months and includes at least 1 month of active-phase symptoms.

assertions.subject: Schizophrenia
assertions.quote: Schizophrenia lasts for at least 6 months and includes at least 1 month of active-phase symptoms.

assertions.subject: Schizoaffective disorder
assertions.quote: In schizoaffective disorder, a mood episode and the active-phase symptoms of schizophrenia occur together and were preceded or are followed by at least 2 weeks of delusions or hallucinations without prominent mood symptoms.

assertions.subject: Substance/medication—induced psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: In substance/medication—induced psychotic disorder, the psychotic symptoms are judged to be a physiological consequence of a drug of abuse, a medication, or toxin exposure and cease after removal of the agent.

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder due to another medical condition
assertions.quote: In psychotic disorder due to another medical condition, the psychotic symptoms are judged to be a direct physiological consequence of another medical condition.
